[short] skip 'cross-links the standard library for windows'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=windows
env GOARCH=amd64
env CGO_ENABLED=0
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd a/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/wina.exe ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/adep'' reaches ''syscall\.\(\*LazyProc\)\.Call'''
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_net\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/adep'' reaches ''syscall\.\(\*LazyProc\)\.Call'''
cd ../..

cd b/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/winb.exe ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/bdep'' reaches ''syscall\.\(\*Proc\)\.Call'''
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_net\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/bdep'' reaches ''syscall\.\(\*Proc\)\.Call'''
cd ../..

cd c/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/winc.exe ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities::'
cd ../..

cd d/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/wind.exe ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities::'
cd ../..

-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/amain

go 1.27

require example.com/adep v0.0.0

replace example.com/adep => ../dep

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"

-- a/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/adep"

func main() { adep.Init() }

-- a/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/adep

go 1.27

-- a/dep/dep.go --
package adep

import "syscall"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	syscall.NewLazyDLL("kernel32.dll").NewProc("GetCurrentProcessId").Call()
}

-- b/main/go.mod --
module example.com/bmain

go 1.27

require example.com/bdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/bdep => ../dep

-- b/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"

-- b/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/bdep"

func main() { bdep.Init() }

-- b/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/bdep

go 1.27

-- b/dep/dep.go --
package bdep

import "syscall"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	syscall.MustLoadDLL("kernel32.dll").MustFindProc("GetCurrentProcessId").Call()
}

-- c/main/go.mod --
module example.com/cmain

go 1.27

require example.com/cdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/cdep => ../dep

-- c/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"
transitive_exec_allowlist = ["example.com/cdep/**"]
transitive_net_allowlist = ["example.com/cdep/**"]

-- c/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/cdep"

func main() { cdep.Init() }

-- c/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/cdep

go 1.27

-- c/dep/dep.go --
package cdep

import "syscall"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	syscall.NewLazyDLL("kernel32.dll").NewProc("GetCurrentProcessId").Call()
}

-- d/main/go.mod --
module example.com/dmain

go 1.27

require example.com/ddep v0.0.0

replace example.com/ddep => ../dep

-- d/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"

-- d/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/ddep"

func main() { ddep.Init() }

-- d/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/ddep

go 1.27

-- d/dep/dep.go --
package ddep

import (
	"os"
	"syscall"
)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	syscall.Getpid()
	os.Getpid()
	os.ReadFile("go.mod")
}
